reviews.title: Great product
reviews.comment: It doesn’t have enough recognition. But this product is pretty good. The box comes with everything you need. Thermal pads, a screw driver and a copper plate for the ssd as well as tweezers and prying tools. It’s an all in one that has a great price tag. The copper plate helps to reduce the heat around the storage of the device considering the higher the Gb the more heat produced. This fixed the heating issue right away. Works better than the stock foil that surrounds the internal stock ssd. It’s just a matter of taking it apart yourself but there are plenty of youtube tutorials on how to swap out your ssd. This kit will also see future use as it comes with a decent screw driver! 10/10 would buy again.
reviews.author: Jacob

reviews.title: Great heatsink installed on a Legion Go handheld console
reviews.comment: GREAT heatsink! used it to upgrade my Legion Go storage, replacing OEM m.2, with a Crucial one, 2230 format, installing with a converter of course, and my console feels A LOT colder than original way. Easy to install, every single tool and screw displayed was there, including thermal pads which were super easy to install,  so I'm happy with this purchase, would recommend.
reviews.author: Andrés Guerrero

reviews.title: Simple and straight forward kit!
reviews.comment: I purchased this for use with a WD SN740 2TB drive for my Steam Deck. I can't comment if the heatsink itself would have made any actual difference but it was worth it alone for the peace of mind. Comes with all the tools you'll need to open up your Steam Deck as well which is great! A solid kit with everything you'll need!
reviews.author: BigHNut

reviews.title: Everything you need at good price
reviews.comment: It's okay not the best, it comes with a Philips head torx screw driver in two sizes ph0 and ph1, I personally found the screw driver to not be the best quality, but if you're taking off the backplate of a steam deck for SSD installation I recommend using the ph0 torx bit, it's smaller and fits better with the tiny screws. It comes with great thermal pads that increased the speed of the SSD while lower temperatures and thereby also raising performance, it's definitely durable and won't break easily, it's easy to use to take apart the steam deck and to install the SSD, and it's very cheap and good value for the money despite the lower quality torx head, overall it's a good kit to have if you're into building PCs and tech or just a steam deck user who wants a 2 terabyte SSD. It also comes with a tweezer but I misplaced it for now so it's not in my picture, not sure what it's for cuz I didn't need it myself, but yeah it's there. The thermal pads also aren't except one because I already installed it. And it came with screws that can work as backups for you. And a microfiber cloth which is great for cleaning screens and tempered glass PC cases for finger prints and smudges without scratching it at all!
reviews.author: T

reviews.title: Cheap insurance
reviews.comment: It may not do much but it may do just enough to prevent catastrophe. Even though it’s a cheap “bear whistle,” the Boy Scout in me would rather be prepared. Besides, its thermal conductivity, in sum, will be no worse than the chunk of heat transfer silicone it replaces. Cheap insurance if you have SSDs being pushed thermally by nearby Intel Thunderbolt controllers and power supplies.
